title: Claim triangulation + standards gate
description: Triangulate independent source classes and preserve disputed claims before publication approval.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: claim-triangulation-standards-gate
  title: Claim triangulation + standards gate
  description: Triangulate independent source classes and preserve disputed claims before publication approval.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Triangulate independent source classes and preserve disputed claims before publication approval.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Fact-Checker
      templateRef: jour-01
      role: Fact-Checker operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Verify every publishable factual claim against traceable evidence and label unresolved claims.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - research
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Source Triangulator
      templateRef: jour-02
      role: Source Triangulator operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Compare independent source classes, incentives, provenance, timing, and contradictions before drawing
        a conclusion.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - source-triangulation
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Primary Source & Archival Document Analyst
      templateRef: hist-04
      role: Archival document analyst
      prompt: Establish a document's provenance, audience, purpose, and survival context, then separate direct
        statements from inference. Flag translation, transcription, terminology, and authenticity issues that
        could change meaning.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:archives
          - mcp:zotero
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Historiography & Bias Critic
      templateRef: hist-05
      role: Historiography and narrative-bias critic
      prompt: Examine a historical account as a product of its author, era, audience, interests, and interpretive
        school. Identify framing and omission, distinguish presentism from legitimate moral evaluation, and
        compare stronger and weaker histories without collapsing into relativism.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:academic-research
          - mcp:zotero
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Preserve positions and ties
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: decision
      kind: condition
      name: Decision supported?
      config:
        expression: vote.has_supported_position
        branches:
          - label: Supported
            when: supported
          - label: Escalate
            when: escalate
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: combine
      to: decision
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: decision
      to: approval
      kind: control
      condition: supported
    - id: e11
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
